 Presented by DB Jordan Hancock activated and QB Shane Buechele elevated, DB Te'Cory Couch released | Week 10
 Nov 14, 2026 at 03:57 PM Maddy Glab Senior Team Reporter
 Copied! 
 The Bills made a few roster moves ahead of Sunday's Week 10 game against the Jets.
 Buffalo activated defensive back Jordan Hancock from Injured Reserve. To make room for the move, defensive back Te'Cory Couch was released.
 Hancock missed a total of six games and originally was placed on IR following Week 2's Lions game due to a hamstring injury.
 The Bills also elevated quarterback Shane Buechele for Sunday's game. This will be Buechele's first elevation of the season.
